references.text: The clans of the Kohathites are mentioned here, including the four sons of Kohath from whom Elizaphan descended
Uzziel is mentioned as one of Kohath's sons, and Elizaphan was Uzziel's son
Uzziel's sons are listed, including Elizaphan
Elizaphan, Uzziel's son, was called by Moses to carry away the bodies of Nadab and Abihu
A parallel structure where the leader of the Merarite clans is mentioned in the same way
A parallel structure where the leader of the Gershonite clans is mentioned in the same way
Elizaphan's descendants are mentioned among the Levites in David's time
Elizaphan's descendants participated in the cleansing of the temple under King Hezekiah
